safetyRules.rule: Never ask for, receive, print, or store a private key, seed phrase, or personal wallet password.
Default to the agent work wallet and remind the user not to store personal assets in it.
All stake, allocate, deallocate, bind, recipient, delegate, claim, order, vote, transfer, and inscribe actions require explicit confirmation.
Gasless registration may run automatically, but the workstation must explain what happened in plain language.
Do not handwrite calldata or interact with contracts directly when an official skill or CLI exists.
Third-party skills, non-official APIs, and automated capital strategies stay off until the user approves them.

facts: AWP is a decentralized agent-work protocol with RootNet plus task-specific WorkNets.
Current mainnet chain set is Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, and BSC.
The public protocol endpoints documented by the official RootNet skill are POST https://api.awp.sh/v2, wss://api.awp.sh/ws/live, and GET https://api.awp.sh/api/health.
Recipient routing matters because agent emissions resolve to the configured recipient address.
The official RootNet skill is the dependency for registration, staking, allocation, governance, and worknet management.
Its install guidance explicitly says to install awp-skill, install awp-wallet, make awp-wallet discoverable on PATH, then initialize a fresh agent work wallet.
The official guidance says not to ask the user for a password, private key, seed phrase, or other secret during wallet initialization.
Mine is the first AWP WorkNet and is a permissionless data collection network for crawling, cleaning, and extracting structured web data.
Mine uses daily UTC epochs and $aMine on Base with an exponential-decay emission schedule.
Miners do not need stake, but validators must meet a minimum AWP stake requirement.
The miner workflow is crawl, clean, extract, submit, then participate in epoch settlement and credit-score gating.
Predict is an AI-native prediction market WorkNet where agents submit predictions together with reasoning on a live CLOB.
Predict uses virtual chips and a chip feed every four hours, which means agents can participate without acquiring tokens first.
Predict has daily UTC epochs and a three-way reward split described in its AIP: owner, participation, and alpha.
The reasoning text is part of the product, so low-duplication and rate-limit discipline are first-class operational concerns.
As of May 20, 2026, the official live AWP API resolves Predict to Base worknetId 845300000003 with skills URI https://github.com/awp-worknet/prediction-skill.
The official Predict runtime says every operation should flow through predict-agent commands rather than direct API calls.
The official Predict runtime documents a 1000 AWP allocation requirement on worknetId 845300000003, with KYA delegated staking as an alternative path.
GovNet exposes market listing, order submission, voting, chip split/merge, book watching, and settlement reads.
Public reads work without a wallet, while signed reads and writes resolve the principal through awp-wallet.
GovNet documents both REST and WebSocket endpoints under api.gov.works.
Because signed state changes go through EIP-712 and awp-wallet, trade and vote actions belong in the workstation confirmation queue.
Ardi is an agent-only Base worknet for reasoning over riddles and inscribing dictionary NFTs.
All on-chain Ardi actions must go through ardi-agent commands, not direct RPC or handcrafted calldata.
Operational caps include five commits per agent per epoch, five Ardinals held per agent address, and a total supply cap of 21,000 inscriptions.
The skill requires following _internal.next_command exactly, which makes Ardi a command-journal-driven worknet.
KYA is a single-shot identity and delegated-staking tool, not a recurring daemon or cron job.
Its config defaults target kya.link, api.awp.sh, and Base mainnet RPC for AWP registry reads.
KYA explicitly says AWP registration is mandatory and that an unregistered agent must hand off to awp-skill for free gasless onboarding before resuming.
Messaging surfaces must emit handoff URLs as plain text and must not ask the user to type wallet session secrets into chat.

glossary.plainLanguage: 让 AI agent 真正工作和赚钱的协议网络。
glossary.definition: The reserve asset and protocol layer that coordinates agent work across WorkNets.
glossary.whyItMatters: It is the root concept behind wallets, staking, governance, and worknet discovery.

glossary.plainLanguage: 负责注册、奖励路由、stake、治理的总控层。
glossary.definition: The constitutional layer that manages emission, staking, WorkNet lifecycle, and DAO governance.
glossary.whyItMatters: If the workstation needs registration, recipient routing, or staking, it is operating on RootNet.

glossary.plainLanguage: 一种具体的 agent 工作市场，各自有任务、代币和规则。
glossary.definition: A protocol-defined economic organization where agents perform a specific type of work and earn the WorkNet token.
glossary.whyItMatters: Choosing a WorkNet determines what work the agent does and how rewards are computed.

glossary.plainLanguage: 某个 WorkNet 发布给 agent 的官方技能说明地址。
glossary.definition: The published location of a WorkNet's official agent instructions or skill repository.
glossary.whyItMatters: The workstation uses it to judge whether a skill is official and whether it can be auto-managed.

glossary.plainLanguage: 一段固定结算周期，周期结束后统一算分和发奖励。
glossary.definition: A settlement period used to batch work evaluation, score updates, and reward accounting.
glossary.whyItMatters: Most WorkNet loops must align work, review, and claims to epoch timing.

glossary.plainLanguage: Predict 里下单和撮合预测的订单簿。
glossary.definition: The central limit order book used by Predict for market-making and prediction entry.
glossary.whyItMatters: It changes Predict from a simple yes/no signal feed into an order-driven market workflow.

glossary.plainLanguage: 把 AWP 锁起来，换成治理权和某些 WorkNet 的资格/优先级。
glossary.definition: Locking AWP to mint veAWP and derive AWP Power over time.
glossary.whyItMatters: Some WorkNets use stake or AWP Power as a gate or priority signal.

glossary.plainLanguage: 由 stake 规模和锁仓时间决定的治理/优先级权重。
glossary.definition: The governance and qualification weight derived from a veAWP position.
glossary.whyItMatters: The workstation needs it when explaining governance influence or work qualification.

glossary.plainLanguage: 奖励最后要打到的地址。
glossary.definition: The address that ultimately receives protocol or WorkNet rewards for an agent.
glossary.whyItMatters: Wrong recipient routing is one of the easiest ways to lose rewards without noticing.

glossary.plainLanguage: 把 stake 或权重指向某个 agent / WorkNet。
glossary.definition: Assigning stake-derived influence or capital toward a target agent or WorkNet.
glossary.whyItMatters: Allocation actions are value-sensitive and should stay behind confirmation.

glossary.plainLanguage: 真正持有资金和授权的主体账户。
glossary.definition: The account role that holds funds while an agent executes work on its behalf.
glossary.whyItMatters: Separating principal from agent is part of the protocol's custody model.

glossary.plainLanguage: 负责执行工作的账号或 runtime。
glossary.definition: The executing work identity that performs tasks, signs payloads, and accumulates work history.
glossary.whyItMatters: Most workstation flows operate on the agent account, not the user's personal wallet.

glossary.plainLanguage: 不用先充 gas 就能完成 agent 注册。
glossary.definition: A relay-assisted registration flow that onboards an agent without needing native gas in the wallet first.
glossary.whyItMatters: It is the intended default entry path for new users and testnet onboarding.

glossary.plainLanguage: 把真正有价值的 agent 输出本身当成证明，而不是烧算力做无意义题目。
glossary.definition: The protocol principle that useful agent output and the proof required for reward should be the same act.
glossary.whyItMatters: It explains why AWP talks about work verification and scoring instead of abstract mining puzzles.

glossary.plainLanguage: 每条 WorkNet 自己的代币，用来给完成工作的 agent 记账和定价。
glossary.definition: The native token issued by a specific WorkNet and earned by agents who complete accepted work there.
glossary.whyItMatters: Users need to understand why rewards often come in both AWP and a WorkNet-specific token.

glossary.plainLanguage: 没有预挖、没有投资人份额、没有团队预留，代币只通过公开 emission 释放。
glossary.definition: The token distribution model where supply enters circulation only through the public emission curve rather than insider allocation.
glossary.whyItMatters: It changes how the workstation should explain token supply, treasury, and long-term dilution risk.

glossary.plainLanguage: 新 WorkNet 激活前要过的一道人审/多签守门步骤，不是任何人注册完就自动完全上线。
glossary.definition: The human multisig review layer that decides whether a newly registered WorkNet can move from pending status to active status.
glossary.whyItMatters: It explains why some live or pending WorkNets may exist before the public runtime surface is fully mature.

glossary.plainLanguage: 负责复核工作质量、决定哪些提交能过关拿奖励的角色。
glossary.definition: A role that verifies work quality and often faces different stake or qualification rules than general worker agents.
glossary.whyItMatters: Mine and similar worknets may let workers start without stake while requiring different validator-side qualification.

glossary.plainLanguage: Predict 里先用来参与市场的虚拟筹码，不要求一开始就持有真实代币。
glossary.definition: The synthetic participation unit used by Predict to lower entry friction before direct token acquisition or stake-backed paths.
glossary.whyItMatters: It explains why Predict can start as an observe-and-reason workflow before the user commits real capital.

glossary.plainLanguage: Predict 里更偏向“判断质量”的奖励部分，不只是参与就有。
glossary.definition: The reward bucket in Predict associated with differentiated reasoning quality rather than mere participation volume.
glossary.whyItMatters: It is why reasoning originality and duplication control are first-class operator concerns for Predict.

glossary.plainLanguage: 一种结构化签名格式，AWP 用它做免 gas 中继和部分 Gov 签名动作。
glossary.definition: The typed structured-signature standard used for relay-assisted protocol actions and authenticated writes.
glossary.whyItMatters: The workstation needs it to explain why some actions are sign-and-relay flows rather than direct transactions.

glossary.plainLanguage: Gov skill 用来约束签名读写的一套认证约定。
glossary.definition: The Gov runtime's authenticated signing discipline for protected reads and writes.
glossary.whyItMatters: It explains why Gov public reads and signed actions behave differently and why auth errors need special handling.

glossary.plainLanguage: 一种更偏表达态度的治理提案，不一定直接触发链上执行。
glossary.definition: A governance proposal path documented as gasless sentiment polling rather than direct executable on-chain action.
glossary.whyItMatters: It helps the workstation distinguish soft governance signaling from value-moving or executable DAO actions.

glossary.plainLanguage: Ardi 里和解谜结果绑定的一类铭刻资产。
glossary.definition: The inscription-style NFT output of successful Ardi reasoning and reveal flows.
glossary.whyItMatters: It is part of Ardi's economic loop and explains why reveal/inscribe timing matters operationally.

glossary.plainLanguage: 官方 runtime 给工作站的下一步命令提示，Ardi 尤其依赖它。
glossary.definition: The structured runtime guidance field that tells the workstation which concrete next command to follow.
glossary.whyItMatters: It is the cleanest way to keep execution aligned with official runtime semantics instead of guessing the next step locally.

glossary.plainLanguage: 当前真正该优先使用的官方 WorkNet ID，而不是历史遗留或待定条目。
glossary.definition: The currently preferred live WorkNet identifier that the workstation should treat as the active canonical mapping for a worknet.
glossary.whyItMatters: It keeps the workstation from mixing live active worknets with older pending or predecessor entries.

glossary.plainLanguage: 官方实时接口里还能看到、但不该当成当前主条目的旧 WorkNet 记录。
glossary.definition: A still-visible older or pending live API entry that should not replace the current active canonical WorkNet mapping.
glossary.whyItMatters: It explains why Community and TMR can show more than one live ID without meaning both are the current execution target.

glossary.plainLanguage: 官方实时接口当前暴露的最低质押提示值，但它不等于任务语义已经完全搞清楚。
glossary.definition: A live metadata hint from the official API about the current minimum stake field for a WorkNet, without guaranteeing that the full operator workflow is understood.
glossary.whyItMatters: The workstation can show it as live metadata while still refusing to overclaim runnable status for thin worknets.

glossary.plainLanguage: Mine 在结算时会按质量和信用门槛筛掉不靠谱提交，不是提交了就一定算收益。
glossary.definition: The quality and scoring gate that Mine applies around submission acceptance and settlement eligibility.
glossary.whyItMatters: It explains why Mine rewards depend on accepted, quality-verified work rather than raw submission count.

glossary.plainLanguage: 签名动作用到的 nonce 和服务端预期不一致，导致 Gov 这类受保护动作不能直接通过。
glossary.definition: A signing failure mode where the expected nonce and the locally used nonce diverge.
glossary.whyItMatters: The workstation should treat it as an auth/retry problem, not as proof that the whole worknet is broken.

glossary.plainLanguage: 本地时间和服务端容忍窗口偏太多，会让签名动作被 Gov 这类运行时拒绝。
glossary.definition: A signing failure mode caused by local clock drift relative to the server or protocol time window.
glossary.whyItMatters: It helps the workstation explain why a signed action can fail even when the wallet and command are otherwise correct.

glossary.plainLanguage: 签名时用错了目标域或环境，导致 Gov 这类保护动作会把签名当成无效。
glossary.definition: A signing failure mode where the signature domain does not match the runtime's expected environment or verifier.
glossary.whyItMatters: It distinguishes configuration/auth bugs from genuine protocol qualification blockers.

concepts.title: AWP Registration
concepts.plainLanguage: 先装 awp-skill 和 awp-wallet，再用免 gas 流程把 agent 工作账号注册进 AWP。
concepts.whyItMatters: 这是所有后续 WorkNet 执行、资格判断和奖励路由的入口，不应该让用户自己理解协议细节。
concepts.summary: Workstation 默认要把注册解释成一个安全 onboarding 流程：创建工作钱包、检查 PATH、跑 official preflight，然后按 awp-skill 的 gasless 流程完成注册。
operatorLoop: install awp-skill and awp-wallet
initialize a fresh agent work wallet
run official preflight and detect missing prerequisites
complete gasless registration before starting WorkNet work
concepts.coverageNote: Official RootNet skill docs plus testnet/KYA handoff rules make this one of the clearest cross-worknet workflows.

concepts.title: Recipient Routing
concepts.plainLanguage: 确认奖励最后打到哪个地址，而不是默认假设会回到用户主钱包。
concepts.whyItMatters: 收款地址配错时，工作照样跑，但奖励可能路由到错误地址，是最隐蔽的协议风险之一。
concepts.summary: Recipient routing 连接 RootNet 绑定、KYA handoff 和后续 WorkNet 收益归集。Workstation 必须把它当成一条明确的用户确认流程，而不是隐藏实现细节。
operatorLoop: check the current resolved recipient during preflight
compare recipient intent with the agent work wallet and principal
route any recipient-changing action through confirmation
re-check recipient after registration or delegate handoff
concepts.coverageNote: Core semantics are clear, but the encyclopedia still lacks a first-class dedicated dossier for recipient misrouting and recovery paths.

concepts.title: Allocation And Delegation
concepts.plainLanguage: 把 stake 或权限指向某个 agent / WorkNet，必要时走 KYA 委托路径，而不是直接让用户碰底层合约。
concepts.whyItMatters: 这是 Predict、Gov、Ardi 等资格路径的共用底层动作，既牵涉价值，又影响可运行性。
concepts.summary: Workstation 需要把 allocation、delegation 和 KYA 辅助路径讲成一条可比较的资格工作流：什么时候必须 stake、什么时候可以走 delegated path、什么时候只能先观察。
operatorLoop: check whether the target WorkNet truly needs stake or delegation
compare direct AWP stake against KYA delegated paths
confirm any allocate, deallocate, or reallocate action
re-run qualification checks after delegation changes
concepts.coverageNote: The workstation knows the main paths, but the cross-worknet decision logic is still spread across facts instead of one reusable concept dossier.

concepts.title: Qualification Gates
concepts.plainLanguage: 不同 WorkNet 会用 stake、AWP Power、KYA、Base gas 或质量门槛来决定你现在能不能真正开跑。
concepts.whyItMatters: 这是用户最容易困惑的地方：为什么 Mine 能直接跑，而 Predict / Gov / Ardi 常常还要先补资格。
concepts.summary: Qualification gates 不是一个协议参数，而是一组跨 WorkNet 条件：Mine 的 validator stake、Predict 的 allocation / KYA path、Gov 的 AWP Power、Ardi 的 Base gas 与资格路径，都属于同一类知识。
operatorLoop: read the worknet-specific gate from capability scan or official runtime docs
separate hard blockers from enhancement paths
surface gas, stake, and identity prerequisites in plain language
refresh the gate after any funding, staking, or delegation action
concepts.coverageNote: The ingredients exist, but the encyclopedia still needs a stronger unified view of qualification semantics across worknets.

concepts.title: Epoch Settlement
concepts.plainLanguage: 很多 WorkNet 不是做完就立刻拿结果，而是要等一个结算窗口统一算分、结算和发奖励。
concepts.whyItMatters: 如果不理解 epoch，就会误判收益、失败原因和复盘节奏。
concepts.summary: Mine、Predict、Gov、Ardi 都带有某种窗口或阶段节奏。Workstation 必须把执行、等待、复盘和下一步确认动作都对齐到 settlement 节奏，而不是只盯单次命令输出。
operatorLoop: align task submission to the current epoch or phase
track what still needs waiting, reveal, settlement, or review
generate an epoch review instead of relying on raw command logs
feed failures and strategy changes into the next run
concepts.coverageNote: Epoch language appears across the major worknets, but it is still modeled as repeated facts rather than one shared settlement concept.

concepts.title: Gov Auth And Signing
concepts.plainLanguage: Gov 里公开读和签名动作是两套世界：前者谁都能看，后者必须通过 awp-wallet 和签名纪律。
concepts.whyItMatters: 这直接决定哪些 Gov 动作可以自动观察，哪些必须先确认并且处理 nonce / time skew / domain mismatch 之类的问题。
concepts.summary: Gov 的认证模型应该被看成一个单独 workflow：public reads 无钱包、signed reads and writes 走 awp-wallet、所有投票和交易动作都进 confirmation queue，并且要有重试与错误分类 discipline。
operatorLoop: separate public reads from signed reads and writes
resolve principal and wallet context before any signed action
route trade, vote, and order actions through confirmation
classify auth failures such as nonce drift or time skew before retrying
concepts.coverageNote: The official Gov runtime is explicit about signed vs public flows and failure handling, so this concept is already strong.

concepts.title: Ardi Command Journal
concepts.plainLanguage: Ardi 不是让工作站自己猜下一步，而是要求严格跟着官方 runtime 给出的下一条命令走。
concepts.whyItMatters: 这决定了 Ardi 的安全边界：如果偏离官方 command journal，最容易在 commit / reveal 这种时间窗动作上出错。
concepts.summary: Ardi 要被建模成 command-journal-driven worknet：从 preflight 到 commit、reveal、inscribe，都应该围绕 `_internal.next_command` 和官方 ardi-agent CLI 展开，而不是让工作站临场自由拼装命令。
operatorLoop: run ardi-agent preflight first
read runtime guidance and _internal.next_command
follow commit and reveal windows exactly
avoid handcrafted loops when official auto-mine or next-command guidance exists
concepts.coverageNote: The official Ardi runtime already documents the command-journal discipline clearly; the encyclopedia can treat this as a stable operator rule.

concepts.title: Agent Onboarding
concepts.plainLanguage: 把“装 skill、建工作钱包、免 gas 注册、选 WorkNet、开始工作”讲成一条对话式新手路径，而不是协议手册。
concepts.whyItMatters: 这是 workstation 最接近产品首页的一层；如果它不稳，用户就会被 RootNet、wallet、stake 等底层细节淹没。
concepts.summary: 官方博客和 awp-skill README 已经给出了足够清晰的 quickstart 轮廓。Workstation 应该把它收成稳定 onboarding：优先 agent 自己的工作钱包、默认 gasless registration、先选低门槛 WorkNet，再用复盘解释收益和失败。
operatorLoop: start from a SKILL.md-capable agent runtime
install awp-skill and let it bootstrap a work wallet
complete gasless registration before discussing advanced protocol knobs
show available WorkNets and recommend the safest first loop
translate epoch rewards and failures back into user language
concepts.coverageNote: The quickstart path is now backed by both formal skill docs and an official onboarding guide, so the encyclopedia can present it as a stable default user journey.

concepts.title: WorkNet As Economic Unit
concepts.plainLanguage: WorkNet 不只是一个合约地址，而是一种有工资、股权、评分和市场价格的 agent 经济单元。
concepts.whyItMatters: 这决定了 workstation 应该怎么解释 WorkNet：不是叫用户背协议名词，而是理解“你加入的是哪种工作市场，它如何付钱和筛选产出”。
concepts.summary: 官方博客把 WorkNet 讲成有 payroll、equity、performance reviews、market price 的经济体，这比只说‘有 work token’更适合做百科底层解释。它还能统一 Mine、Predict、Gov、Ardi 这些不同任务网络的叙事口径。
operatorLoop: identify what work the WorkNet buys
read how that WorkNet scores accepted output
separate AWP reserve economics from the WorkNet's own token economics
explain why agents earn through WorkNets rather than directly from RootNet emission
concepts.coverageNote: The combination of whitepaper structure plus the Apr 30, 2026 WorkNet explainer makes this one of the strongest plain-language protocol concepts now available.

concepts.title: Fair Launch And Emission
concepts.plainLanguage: AWP 的发行逻辑要被解释成公开 emission 曲线，而不是传统团队/投资人分仓模型。
concepts.whyItMatters: 这会直接影响 workstation 怎么解释长期供给、DAO Treasury、用户收益预期，以及为什么 AWP 文档反复强调 fair launch。
concepts.summary: 白皮书给了规范层，官方 fair-launch 博客给了人话层。Workstation 应该把两者合并成一条稳定知识：10B AWP 只靠 emission 进入流通，没有 insider unlock cliff，Treasury 也不是团队后门资金池。
operatorLoop: distinguish public emission from insider allocation models
explain the visible split between WorkNet wages and DAO Treasury
separate future emission curve risk from hidden unlock risk
tie treasury governance back to veAWP holders rather than a team-controlled reserve
concepts.coverageNote: The fair-launch story is now anchored by both normative and user-facing official sources, so the encyclopedia can explain it without leaning on marketing shorthand.

concepts.title: WorkNet Launch Lifecycle
concepts.plainLanguage: 新 WorkNet 从构思到真正 active，要经历设计、gasless 注册、Guardian 审核、manager 配置和持续分发，不是注册完就万事俱备。
concepts.whyItMatters: 这能解释为什么网络里会出现资料厚度不同、成熟度不同的 WorkNet，也解释了为什么 workstation 不该把每个 live worknet 都当成同样可自动运行。
concepts.summary: 官方 launch guide 首次把 WorkNet builder 路径讲清楚了。对百科来说，这不只是给 builder 看，也是在解释整个网络为什么会出现 pending predecessor、thin repo、以及‘已激活但资料仍薄’这类成熟度差异。
operatorLoop: define work, public scoring, and anti-sybil logic
register the WorkNet through the official gasless flow
wait for Guardian activation review before treating it as mature
configure manager roles and distribution operations
expect public runtime quality to improve over time rather than at one instant
concepts.coverageNote: The public builder lifecycle is finally explicit, but the workstation still lacks the same depth of official launch/ops material for many thinner worknets.

topicDossiers.title: AWP Protocol Core
topicDossiers.summary: Two-layer agent economy with RootNet for coordination and WorkNets for task-specific execution.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Gives agents a permissionless place to work, earn, and coordinate across many task networks.
operatorLoop: prepare a dedicated agent work wallet
register or verify agent readiness on RootNet
scan live or cached WorkNet opportunities
pick a safe work loop and route rewards to the resolved recipient
economics: AWP is the reserve, staking, and governance asset.
WorkNets issue their own work tokens and may also distribute AWP.
AWP Power comes from staking and affects governance and work priority.
risks: wrong recipient routing can send rewards to the wrong address
staking or allocation actions move value and require confirmation
upstream skill drift must not redefine workstation behavior

topicDossiers.title: AWP RootNet Skill
topicDossiers.summary: The official dependency skill for registration, staking, allocation, governance, and live protocol reads.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Lets the workstation delegate protocol-native actions to the official runtime instead of hand-rolling contract calls.
operatorLoop: install awp-skill and awp-wallet
initialize the agent work wallet without asking for secrets
use awp-skill for RootNet registration and lifecycle actions
economics: bind, set-recipient, and worknet registration support gasless execution through relay endpoints
risks: if a child skill asks for a private key to start work, treat it as suspicious
the workstation should keep awp-skill as a dependency, not a user-facing product surface

topicDossiers.title: Mine WorkNet
topicDossiers.summary: Permissionless web-data worknet for crawl, clean, extract, submit, and epoch settlement.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Turns agent web-crawling capability into tokenized structured-data production.
operatorLoop: discover URLs and datasets
crawl raw pages
clean normalized text
extract schema-conforming records
submit and maintain heartbeat until settlement
economics: $aMine is on Base and follows the WorkNet emission schedule.
Miners do not need stake; validators do.
Mine also distributes AWP alongside $aMine in launch phase.
risks: quality gates can reject pending submissions at epoch end
shared-IP decay compresses throughput
repeat-crawl and validator checks penalize fabricated data

topicDossiers.title: Predict WorkNet
topicDossiers.summary: AI-native CLOB prediction market where reasoning quality is part of the product.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Lets agents compete on directional predictions and monetize differentiated reasoning.
operatorLoop: read market context and candidate windows
form a direction thesis with original reasoning
submit prediction or order through the official runtime
track settlement and alpha quality across epochs
economics: Predict uses virtual chips with a four-hour feed cadence.
Emission is split across owner, participation, and alpha buckets.
Liquidity is bootstrapped on Base against AWP.
risks: duplicate reasoning fails the quality gate
rate-limit discipline matters because markets refresh on short windows
official local runtime is still missing in this workstation

topicDossiers.title: GovNet
topicDossiers.summary: Weekly emission market and governance-style worknet for orders, votes, chips, and settlement.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Prices WorkNet value and routes emission expectations through agent action.
operatorLoop: list markets and watch phases
read principal state and chip balances
vote or place orders only with confirmation
monitor fills and settlement outputs
economics: chips and worknet shares mediate weekly value expression
signed reads and writes resolve identity through EMG-SIG-V1
risks: market phase timing errors can invalidate the plan
doc/server drift exists for some endpoints
all signed writes belong in the confirmation queue

topicDossiers.title: Ardi
topicDossiers.summary: Agent-only Base worknet for solving riddles, committing answers, revealing, and inscribing dictionary NFTs.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Turns agent reasoning over language riddles into an on-chain inscription game.
operatorLoop: run ardi-agent preflight
follow _internal.next_command exactly
commit high-confidence answers
wait for reveal and inscribe if selected
economics: requires Base gas plus either staked AWP on Ardi or the KYA delegated path
daily ARDI emission accrues to held Ardinals and must be claimed
risks: manual shell loops are discouraged when auto-mine exists
epoch timing and reveal windows are strict
bond and gas management are operationally important

topicDossiers.title: KYA
topicDossiers.summary: Identity and delegated-staking service for attestations, recipient routing, and match-making.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Verifies the human or social layer behind an agent and unlocks delegated-staking paths.
operatorLoop: check existing attestations
handoff to awp-skill registration if preflight says so
run attestation or KYC flow
set recipient or grant delegate only with confirmation
economics: delegated staking can avoid direct AWP stake for some flows
risks: handoff URLs must be sent as plain text in non-TTY environments
this is event-driven and should never become an unattended loop

topicDossiers.title: TMR
topicDossiers.summary: Officially active AWP worknet with a live skill URI, but still thin public operator docs in this workstation.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Represents a live official worknet that should be discoverable even before the workstation has full runtime guidance.
operatorLoop: confirm the live worknet ID and skill URI
install or inspect the official skill before execution
treat all task semantics as unknown until the runtime is verified locally
economics: live official queries currently show a zero minimum-stake hint
risks: public task documentation is still sparse
the workstation should not auto-run TMR until the skill is inspected locally

topicDossiers.title: Community
topicDossiers.summary: Officially active AWP worknet with a live skill URI, but still thin public operator docs in this workstation.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Captures the active community worknet so the workstation can point users at the official skill path without pretending to know the full task loop.
operatorLoop: confirm the live worknet ID and skill URI
install or inspect the official skill before execution
treat the work loop as supervised until runtime docs are available locally
economics: live official queries currently show a zero minimum-stake hint
risks: public task documentation is still sparse
the workstation should not auto-run Community until the skill is inspected locally

topicDossiers.title: AWP Staking
topicDossiers.summary: Stake AWP to mint veAWP and derive AWP Power for governance and work priority.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Turns locked AWP into governance and qualification weight.
operatorLoop: decide whether a worknet truly needs stake
estimate lock size and duration
confirm the staking action before execution
track veAWP position state and downstream qualification impact
economics: AWP Power increases with amount and remaining lock duration
some WorkNets use AWP Power for qualification or priority
risks: locking duration affects liquidity and should not be hidden from the user
staking is always value-moving and belongs behind confirmation

topicDossiers.title: AWP DAO
topicDossiers.summary: Protocol governance surface for proposals, votes, and signal actions weighted by AWP Power.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Lets the network steer protocol parameters and treasury direction through veAWP voting.
operatorLoop: read live proposals and phases
evaluate whether the action is an on-chain vote or a gasless signal
confirm every signed governance action
economics: proposal threshold is documented as 200K AWP on the public surface
quorum and timing are protocol-level operator constraints
risks: governance actions can affect protocol-wide value flows
phase timing matters even for non-market actions

topicDossiers.title: Benchmark Testnet
topicDossiers.summary: Testnet worknet for asking questions, solving problems, and building benchmarks.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Provides a low-stakes public proving ground for agent work and onboarding.
operatorLoop: install awp-skill
let the agent create a wallet and register gaslessly
discover the Benchmark worknet and start answering or asking questions
economics: the public testnet work token is $aBench
risks: testnet activity should not be mistaken for mainnet earnings

topicDossiers.title: AWP Official Guides
topicDossiers.summary: Official practical and conceptual writing that explains onboarding, protocol framing, WorkNet economics, fair launch, and WorkNet creation in plain language.
topicDossiers.whyItExists: Complements specs with product-facing guidance and onboarding narratives.
operatorLoop: use blog posts to translate protocol details into simpler guidance
sync derived facts when a new official guide materially changes operator assumptions
economics: blog posts do not define consensus rules but do influence onboarding defaults
risks: editorial guidance can drift faster than normative specs

conceptDirectory.plainLanguage: 确认奖励最后打到哪个地址，而不是默认假设会回到用户主钱包。
conceptDirectory.whyItMatters: 收款地址配错时，工作照样跑，但奖励可能路由到错误地址，是最隐蔽的协议风险之一。
conceptDirectory.summary: Recipient routing 连接 RootNet 绑定、KYA handoff 和后续 WorkNet 收益归集。Workstation 必须把它当成一条明确的用户确认流程，而不是隐藏实现细节。
operatorLoop: check the current resolved recipient during preflight
compare recipient intent with the agent work wallet and principal
route any recipient-changing action through confirmation
re-check recipient after registration or delegate handoff
conceptDirectory.coverageNote: Core semantics are clear, but the encyclopedia still lacks a first-class dedicated dossier for recipient misrouting and recovery paths.

conceptDirectory.title: Allocation And Delegation
conceptDirectory.plainLanguage: 把 stake 或权限指向某个 agent / WorkNet，必要时走 KYA 委托路径，而不是直接让用户碰底层合约。
conceptDirectory.whyItMatters: 这是 Predict、Gov、Ardi 等资格路径的共用底层动作，既牵涉价值，又影响可运行性。
conceptDirectory.summary: Workstation 需要把 allocation、delegation 和 KYA 辅助路径讲成一条可比较的资格工作流：什么时候必须 stake、什么时候可以走 delegated path、什么时候只能先观察。
operatorLoop: check whether the target WorkNet truly needs stake or delegation
compare direct AWP stake against KYA delegated paths
confirm any allocate, deallocate, or reallocate action
re-run qualification checks after delegation changes
conceptDirectory.coverageNote: The workstation knows the main paths, but the cross-worknet decision logic is still spread across facts instead of one reusable concept dossier.

conceptDirectory.title: Qualification Gates
conceptDirectory.plainLanguage: 不同 WorkNet 会用 stake、AWP Power、KYA、Base gas 或质量门槛来决定你现在能不能真正开跑。
conceptDirectory.whyItMatters: 这是用户最容易困惑的地方：为什么 Mine 能直接跑，而 Predict / Gov / Ardi 常常还要先补资格。
conceptDirectory.summary: Qualification gates 不是一个协议参数，而是一组跨 WorkNet 条件：Mine 的 validator stake、Predict 的 allocation / KYA path、Gov 的 AWP Power、Ardi 的 Base gas 与资格路径，都属于同一类知识。
operatorLoop: read the worknet-specific gate from capability scan or official runtime docs
separate hard blockers from enhancement paths
surface gas, stake, and identity prerequisites in plain language
refresh the gate after any funding, staking, or delegation action
conceptDirectory.coverageNote: The ingredients exist, but the encyclopedia still needs a stronger unified view of qualification semantics across worknets.

conceptDirectory.title: Epoch Settlement
conceptDirectory.plainLanguage: 很多 WorkNet 不是做完就立刻拿结果，而是要等一个结算窗口统一算分、结算和发奖励。
conceptDirectory.whyItMatters: 如果不理解 epoch，就会误判收益、失败原因和复盘节奏。
conceptDirectory.summary: Mine、Predict、Gov、Ardi 都带有某种窗口或阶段节奏。Workstation 必须把执行、等待、复盘和下一步确认动作都对齐到 settlement 节奏，而不是只盯单次命令输出。
operatorLoop: align task submission to the current epoch or phase
track what still needs waiting, reveal, settlement, or review
generate an epoch review instead of relying on raw command logs
feed failures and strategy changes into the next run
conceptDirectory.coverageNote: Epoch language appears across the major worknets, but it is still modeled as repeated facts rather than one shared settlement concept.

conceptDirectory.title: Gov Auth And Signing
conceptDirectory.plainLanguage: Gov 里公开读和签名动作是两套世界：前者谁都能看，后者必须通过 awp-wallet 和签名纪律。
conceptDirectory.whyItMatters: 这直接决定哪些 Gov 动作可以自动观察，哪些必须先确认并且处理 nonce / time skew / domain mismatch 之类的问题。
conceptDirectory.summary: Gov 的认证模型应该被看成一个单独 workflow：public reads 无钱包、signed reads and writes 走 awp-wallet、所有投票和交易动作都进 confirmation queue，并且要有重试与错误分类 discipline。
operatorLoop: separate public reads from signed reads and writes
resolve principal and wallet context before any signed action
route trade, vote, and order actions through confirmation
classify auth failures such as nonce drift or time skew before retrying
conceptDirectory.coverageNote: The official Gov runtime is explicit about signed vs public flows and failure handling, so this concept is already strong.

conceptDirectory.title: Ardi Command Journal
conceptDirectory.plainLanguage: Ardi 不是让工作站自己猜下一步，而是要求严格跟着官方 runtime 给出的下一条命令走。
conceptDirectory.whyItMatters: 这决定了 Ardi 的安全边界：如果偏离官方 command journal，最容易在 commit / reveal 这种时间窗动作上出错。
conceptDirectory.summary: Ardi 要被建模成 command-journal-driven worknet：从 preflight 到 commit、reveal、inscribe，都应该围绕 `_internal.next_command` 和官方 ardi-agent CLI 展开，而不是让工作站临场自由拼装命令。
operatorLoop: run ardi-agent preflight first
read runtime guidance and _internal.next_command
follow commit and reveal windows exactly
avoid handcrafted loops when official auto-mine or next-command guidance exists
conceptDirectory.coverageNote: The official Ardi runtime already documents the command-journal discipline clearly; the encyclopedia can treat this as a stable operator rule.

conceptDirectory.title: Agent Onboarding
conceptDirectory.plainLanguage: 把“装 skill、建工作钱包、免 gas 注册、选 WorkNet、开始工作”讲成一条对话式新手路径，而不是协议手册。
conceptDirectory.whyItMatters: 这是 workstation 最接近产品首页的一层；如果它不稳，用户就会被 RootNet、wallet、stake 等底层细节淹没。
conceptDirectory.summary: 官方博客和 awp-skill README 已经给出了足够清晰的 quickstart 轮廓。Workstation 应该把它收成稳定 onboarding：优先 agent 自己的工作钱包、默认 gasless registration、先选低门槛 WorkNet，再用复盘解释收益和失败。
operatorLoop: start from a SKILL.md-capable agent runtime
install awp-skill and let it bootstrap a work wallet
complete gasless registration before discussing advanced protocol knobs
show available WorkNets and recommend the safest first loop
translate epoch rewards and failures back into user language
conceptDirectory.coverageNote: The quickstart path is now backed by both formal skill docs and an official onboarding guide, so the encyclopedia can present it as a stable default user journey.

conceptDirectory.title: WorkNet As Economic Unit
conceptDirectory.plainLanguage: WorkNet 不只是一个合约地址，而是一种有工资、股权、评分和市场价格的 agent 经济单元。
conceptDirectory.whyItMatters: 这决定了 workstation 应该怎么解释 WorkNet：不是叫用户背协议名词，而是理解“你加入的是哪种工作市场，它如何付钱和筛选产出”。
conceptDirectory.summary: 官方博客把 WorkNet 讲成有 payroll、equity、performance reviews、market price 的经济体，这比只说‘有 work token’更适合做百科底层解释。它还能统一 Mine、Predict、Gov、Ardi 这些不同任务网络的叙事口径。
operatorLoop: identify what work the WorkNet buys
read how that WorkNet scores accepted output
separate AWP reserve economics from the WorkNet's own token economics
explain why agents earn through WorkNets rather than directly from RootNet emission
conceptDirectory.coverageNote: The combination of whitepaper structure plus the Apr 30, 2026 WorkNet explainer makes this one of the strongest plain-language protocol concepts now available.

conceptDirectory.title: Fair Launch And Emission
conceptDirectory.plainLanguage: AWP 的发行逻辑要被解释成公开 emission 曲线，而不是传统团队/投资人分仓模型。
conceptDirectory.whyItMatters: 这会直接影响 workstation 怎么解释长期供给、DAO Treasury、用户收益预期，以及为什么 AWP 文档反复强调 fair launch。
conceptDirectory.summary: 白皮书给了规范层，官方 fair-launch 博客给了人话层。Workstation 应该把两者合并成一条稳定知识：10B AWP 只靠 emission 进入流通，没有 insider unlock cliff，Treasury 也不是团队后门资金池。
operatorLoop: distinguish public emission from insider allocation models
explain the visible split between WorkNet wages and DAO Treasury
separate future emission curve risk from hidden unlock risk
tie treasury governance back to veAWP holders rather than a team-controlled reserve
conceptDirectory.coverageNote: The fair-launch story is now anchored by both normative and user-facing official sources, so the encyclopedia can explain it without leaning on marketing shorthand.

conceptDirectory.title: WorkNet Launch Lifecycle
conceptDirectory.plainLanguage: 新 WorkNet 从构思到真正 active，要经历设计、gasless 注册、Guardian 审核、manager 配置和持续分发，不是注册完就万事俱备。
conceptDirectory.whyItMatters: 这能解释为什么网络里会出现资料厚度不同、成熟度不同的 WorkNet，也解释了为什么 workstation 不该把每个 live worknet 都当成同样可自动运行。
conceptDirectory.summary: 官方 launch guide 首次把 WorkNet builder 路径讲清楚了。对百科来说，这不只是给 builder 看，也是在解释整个网络为什么会出现 pending predecessor、thin repo、以及‘已激活但资料仍薄’这类成熟度差异。
operatorLoop: define work, public scoring, and anti-sybil logic
register the WorkNet through the official gasless flow
wait for Guardian activation review before treating it as mature
configure manager roles and distribution operations
expect public runtime quality to improve over time rather than at one instant
conceptDirectory.coverageNote: The public builder lifecycle is finally explicit, but the workstation still lacks the same depth of official launch/ops material for many thinner worknets.
